0: Ore and timber and prey. A full day.
The bag is not big enough for all of this.
Started underground. Finished in the canopy. Or the reverse.
No time to specialize. No need to.
Did three things at once. Got away with it.
Three trails crossing in the same clearing. Followed all three.
Stone, tree, scent. The day had everything.
The bag took its share from each, and was still light enough to carry.
Worked from soil to bark to bone, all in a morning.
All three roles asked for a paw. All three got one.

light: Something for everyone today, including the hazards.
The forest, the stone, and the mob all had opinions.
Tools tangled three ways. Sorted in two ways. Worked anyway.
Three minor problems in three minutes. Took them in turn.
Slipped, stuck, scratched. The trifecta of small troubles. Walked it off.
Each role got a small reminder of why it is hard. Each role responded.
Inconvenience, three flavors. Carried them all.
moderate: Three problems. One paw at a time.
The stone, the tree, and the mob disagreed about who went first.
All three trades wanted me at once. Picked the loudest first.
Wrong tool in each paw. Switched twice before settling.
Could only do two of the three at once. Did the third afterward.
Bag got heavy in the wrong order. Re-stacked it standing up.
The work multiplied. So did the paws, almost.
severe: Everything happened at once. Still here.
The world had strong opinions. Argued back.
Survived by refusing to specialize in dying.
Tree, stone, and tooth all came after me at once. Made a fourth thing.
All three problems decided to share a clearing. Left the clearing.
Spread thin enough to be in three places at once. Two of them tried to kill me.
Came home with proof of three near-disasters. Did not display the proof.
Should not have walked out of that. Walked out anyway.
